title: Historical South Shore Clear Kayak Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Clearly Tahoe specializes in providing unique guided tours in completely transparent kayaks. Join us for an unforgettable adventure from Camp Richardson Resort and paddle through the crystal clear waters and enjoy a scenic historic shoreline with breathtaking views of Mount Tallac.

Our tours are suitable for all ages and skill levels (5+). 

Guides and kayaks will be ready and waiting on the beach to the west of the Grove and The Beachside Inn. Follow signage from the main parking area. Parking is first come first served and is subject to selling out. Parking fees will be paid directly to Camp Richardson upon entering. Parking is not included nor guaranteed. 

Limitations:
Company policies, age and weight restrictions apply: Guests must be 5 years or older to participate in activity. The total combined weight limit for boats must not exceed 375lbs. Pets are not permitted on this experience.
*Visit us online for full Company Policies*
